title: 移动零
statement: 原地将数组中的所有 0 移至末尾，保持非零元素相对顺序。核心函数不返回值，系统检查修改后的数组。
constraints: 官方 n ≥ 1；本地额外保留空数组作健壮性测试。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行数组长度 n；随后 n 个整数。stdout：修改后的 n 个整数，空数组输出空行。

en.title: Move Zeroes
en.statement: Move all 0s in the array to the end in place, keeping the relative order of the non-zero elements. The function returns nothing; the judge checks the modified array.
constraints: Officially n ≥ 1; an empty array is kept locally as a robustness test.

complexity.space: O(1) extra space; must modify in place
complexity.officialRequirement: The official problem requires in-place operation without copying the array; the follow-up asks to minimize the number of operations.
complexity.notes: n is the number of elements; the input array does not count toward extra space. Copying the array and writing it back fails the in-place requirement even when the output is correct, so review the code.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: first line the array length n; then n integers. stdout: the n modified integers; an empty array prints an empty line.

complexity.space: O(1) 额外空间，必须原地修改
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方要求原地操作，不拷贝数组；follow-up 要求尽量减少操作次数。
complexity.notes: n 为元素数，输入数组不计入额外空间。拷贝数组后写回即使输出正确也不符合原地要求，需检查程序。
